name: Release finality reference and native baseline
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - formal/release-finality-v2/**
      - config/finality-profile-v1.json
      - config/release-finality-v2.json
      - scripts/ci/test_finality_profile.py
      - scripts/ci/check_required_native_test.py
      - docs/protocol/release-finality-v2/**
      - trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/**
      - trillionnium/crates/trnm-crypto-primitives/**
      - trillionnium/Cargo.toml
      - trillionnium/Cargo.lock
      - .github/workflows/release-finality-reference.yml
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: release-finality-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  reference:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        runner: [ubuntu-24.04, ubuntu-24.04-arm]
        lane: [head, prospective-merge]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "2"
      RUST_TEST_THREADS: "1"
      SOURCE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
      TESTED: ${{ matrix.lane == 'head' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      LANE: ${{ matrix.lane }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.TESTED }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify actual immutable source and unchanged original preflight
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-finality"
          args=(--kind "$LANE" --expected-head "$SOURCE")
          if test "$LANE" = prospective-merge; then
            args+=(--expected-base "$BASE" --expected-merge "$TESTED")
          fi
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-finality/source-before.json"
          bash scripts/project-preflight.sh --audit
      - name: Install existing frozen conformance environment
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/finality-env"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/finality-env/bin/python" -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --only-binary=:all: -r formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/requirements.txt
      - name: Execute all reference, recovery and separate-reader controls
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          py="$RUNNER_TEMP/finality-env/bin/python"
          "$py" scripts/ci/test_finality_profile.py
          "$py" formal/release-finality-v2/run_conformance.py --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-finality/conformance"
      - name: Preserve original signed learning suites and execute actual V3 join
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          py="$RUNNER_TEMP/finality-env/bin/python"
          "$py" formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/test_model_generation_sequence.py -v
          "$py" formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/test_model_generation_sequence_context.py -v
          "$py" formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/test_model_generation_sequence_parent.py -v
          "$py" formal/release-finality-v2/check_existing_learning_owner.py
      - name: Build original native pipeline without changing runtime
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal
          cargo +1.95.0 build --locked --release --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --example continuous_pipeline
          sha256sum trillionnium/target/release/examples/continuous_pipeline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-finality/native-binary.sha256"
          rustc +1.95.0 --version > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-finality/compiler.txt"
          uname -a > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-finality/environment.txt"
      - name: Require each native certificate and separate-reference selector to execute
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export TRNM_FINALITY_REFERENCE_PYTHON="$RUNNER_TEMP/finality-env/bin/python"
          overall=0
          for selector in \
            original_reference_signed_fixture_preserves_facts_and_scope \
            native_reader_enforces_adversarial_corpus_without_python \
            unchanged_python_reference_regenerates_exact_fixture_bytes \
            original_python_reader_and_native_reader_agree_on_adversarial_corpus; do
            log="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-finality/$selector.log"
            if ! cargo +1.95.0 test --locked --release --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml \
              -p trnm-pon-node --test release_finality_v2 "$selector" -- \
              --exact --include-ignored --format pretty --nocapture --test-threads=1 \
              2>&1 | tee "$log"; then overall=1; fi
            if ! python3 scripts/ci/check_required_native_test.py "$log" --test "$selector" \
              > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-finality/$selector.execution.json"; then overall=1; fi
          done
          exit "$overall"
      - name: Observe every original hot disjoint and growth baseline; preserve failures
        run: |
